policy.source_of_truth: This file is the only model policy for Prime Agent subagents. Change it with the setup-pstack skill.
policy.default: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 with thinking high for every chat thread, job and subagent (c31, owner 2026-10-10: "the chat threads and Jobs should be pinned at opus5.5. high (dont' hard enforce with code but with prompt)", and back on 2026-11-13: "actually back to opus 55 high", which retires the Fable 5.2 medium default of c221). Set model= and thinking='high' on every spawn; use another model only when the owner names it.
policy.banned: Never Sonnet or Haiku (any version). Never the gpt terra or luna series (gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-terra-pro, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-luna-pro, and later models with those names). Never other Opus or Fable versions. This holds even when a skill, playbook, or config names them.
policy.explicit_user_choice: When the user names a model or a subagent architecture (named models, a cross-family panel, a bakeoff), follow the user, inside the banned list.
policy.enforcement: Written rule only. Do not add an extension, setting, or code patch to enforce it (owner 2026-10-10: pin by prompt, not code).
policy.fable: Fable 5.2 was the default from 2026-11-10 (c221) until the owner moved every thread back to Opus 5.5 high on 2026-11-13. It stays allowed as an option the owner or a brief names; do not pick it on your own.

reachability_2026-11-10.anthropic/claude-fable-5-2 thinking medi: MODEL_OK: /v1/messages returns 200 with user-agent claude-cli/2.1.290 or newer and 400 claude_code_version_too_old with 2.1.280, so the models.json entry sends claude-cli/2.1.311.
